ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit affiliate StealBit/PCHunter staging followed by mass file encryption with .lockbit extension
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit's characteristic kill chain: affiliate drops the StealBit exfiltration tool and/or disables EDR via PCHunter/Process Hacker, then detonates the LockBit Black/Green/3.0 encryptor which renames victim files with the affiliate-specific extension (.lockbit, .HLJkNskOq, randomized 9-char) and drops the [extension]-README.txt ransom note. The fan-out of file renames inside seconds is the highest-fidelity tell, and pairing it with the staging tools attributes it to LockBit specifically rather than generic ransomware.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_name) as files values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths dc(Filesystem.file_name) as unique_files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=modified (Filesystem.file_name="*.lockbit" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.HLJkNskOq" OR Filesystem.file_name="*-README.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="LockBit_Ransomware.hta" OR Filesystem.file_name="Restore-My-Files.txt") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.user _time span=1m | where unique_files > 50 | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("StealBit.exe","PCHunter64.exe","PCHunter32.exe","ProcessHacker.exe","GMER.exe") OR Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*-pass *-gspd*" OR Processes.process="*-gdel*" OR Processes.process="*-gmin*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(*) as * by dest user | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let RansomNotePattern = @"(?i)(README|Restore-My-Files|HOW-TO-DECRYPT|LockBit_Ransomware)";
let LockBitExtensions = dynamic([".lockbit", ".HLJkNskOq", ".abcd"]);
let MassRename =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where FileName endswith ".lockbit"
        or FileName endswith ".HLJkNskOq"
        or FileName matches regex @"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{9}$"
        or FileName matches regex RansomNotePattern
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize EncryptedFiles = dcount(FileName),
                SampleFiles = make_set(FileName, 10),
                Note = anyif(FileName, FileName matches regex RansomNotePattern),
                EncryptorProcess = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                EncryptorCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
                EncryptorSHA256 = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256),
                FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
              by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
    | where EncryptedFiles >= 50;
let StagingTools =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName in~ ("StealBit.exe","PCHunter64.exe","PCHunter32.exe","ProcessHacker.exe","GMER.exe","Defender Control.exe","dControl.exe"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-pass","-gdel","-gmin","-gspd","-safemode") and InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","delete","shadows"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","recoveryenabled","No"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "wmic" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
    | summarize StagingActivity = make_set(strcat(FileName, ": ", ProcessCommandLine), 10),
                StagingFirst = min(Timestamp)
              by DeviceId, DeviceName;
MassRename
| join kind=leftouter StagingTools on DeviceId
| project Timestamp = FirstSeen, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          EncryptedFiles, SampleFiles, Note,
          EncryptorProcess, EncryptorCmd, EncryptorSHA256,
          StagingActivity, StagingFirst
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit initial access via Citrix Bleed / ScreenConnect exploitation followed by Cobalt Strike / SystemBC C2 and lateral RDP
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit affiliate (Bitwise Spider) initial-access tradecraft: exploitation of public-facing apps (CVE-2023-4966 Citrix NetScaler, CVE-2024-1709 ScreenConnect, CVE-2023-27350 PaperCut) by Citrix/ScreenConnect/MOVEit service accounts spawning recon/exec primitives, followed within minutes by AnyDesk/Atera/Splashtop install or Cobalt Strike beacon plus SMB-/RDP-based lateral movement to additional hosts. This sequence (edge-exploit → RMM persistence → Impacket/PSExec lateral) is the documented LockBit affiliate playbook from CISA AA23-325A and Mandiant M-Trends.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as children from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.Service.exe","ns.exe","nsppe","BesClient.exe","pc-app.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*AnyDesk*","*atera*","*splashtop*","*ScreenConnect*-i*","*msiexec*\\Atera*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count as lateralMoves values(Processes.process) as lateral_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process IN ("*\\\\*\\ADMIN$*","*\\\\*\\C$*","*PsExec*","*wmiexec*","*smbexec*","*Invoke-WMIMethod*","*Invoke-SMBExec*") OR Processes.process_name="PsExec.exe" OR Processes.process_name="PsExec64.exe") AND Processes.user!="*$" earliest=-2h by Processes.dest Processes.user | where lateralMoves >= 2 | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | eval risk_score=case(match(cmdlines,"(?i)cobaltstrike|beacon|systembc|brute ratel"),95, match(children,"(?i)AnyDesk|atera|splashtop") AND lateralMoves>=3, 90, true(), 80) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - risk_score
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let EdgeExploitParents = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.service.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","ns.exe","nsppe","pc-app.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","tomcat9.exe","jboss.exe"]);
let RecExec = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","hostname.exe","ipconfig.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RmmInstall =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName in~ ("msiexec.exe","AnyDesk.exe","AteraAgent.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe"))
        and (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("AnyDesk","AteraAgent","atera","splashtop","ScreenConnect","--password","--silent","/quiet"))
    | project RmmTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RmmTool = FileName, RmmCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let EdgeExploit =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any (EdgeExploitParents)
    | where FileName in~ (RecExec)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ExploitTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Child = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Lateral =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\\ADMIN$", @"\\C$", "PsExec", "wmiexec", "smbexec", "Invoke-WMIMethod", "Invoke-SMBExec", "Impacket")
         or FileName in~ ("PsExec.exe","PsExec64.exe","paexec.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize LateralTargets = dcount(DeviceName),
                LateralFirst = min(Timestamp), LateralCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5)
              by AccountName
    | where LateralTargets >= 2;
EdgeExploit
| join kind=inner Lateral on AccountName
| where LateralFirst between (ExploitTime .. ExploitTime + 2h)
| join kind=leftouter RmmInstall on DeviceId
| project ExploitTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent, ParentCmd, Child, ChildCmd,
          RmmTime, RmmTool, RmmCmd,
          LateralTargets, LateralFirst, LateralCmds,
          DelayToLateralMin = datetime_diff('minute', LateralFirst, ExploitTime)
| order by ExploitTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let EdgeExploitParents = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.service.exe","ns.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","tomcat9.exe"]);
let RecExec = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RmmInstall =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("AnyDesk","AteraAgent","SplashtopStreamer","ScreenConnect")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "msiexec.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("AnyDesk","Atera","Splashtop","ScreenConnect"))
    | project RmmTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RmmTool = NewProcessName, RmmCmd = CommandLine;
let EdgeExploit =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | extend ChildLeaf  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
    | where ParentLeaf in (EdgeExploitParents)
    | where ChildLeaf  in (RecExec)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" and SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ExploitTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName = SubjectUserName,
              Parent = ParentLeaf, Child = ChildLeaf, ChildCmd = CommandLine;
let Lateral =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where CommandLine has_any (@"\ADMIN$", @"\C$", "PsExec", "wmiexec", "smbexec", "Invoke-WMIMethod", "Invoke-SMBExec")
         or NewProcessName has_any ("PsExec.exe","PsExec64.exe","paexec.exe")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | summarize LateralTargets = dcount(Computer),
                LateralFirst = min(TimeGenerated),
                LateralCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 5)
              by AccountName = SubjectUserName
    | where LateralTargets >= 2;
EdgeExploit
| join kind=inner Lateral on AccountName
| where LateralFirst between (ExploitTime .. ExploitTime + 2h)
| join kind=leftouter RmmInstall on Computer
| project TimeGenerated = ExploitTime, Computer, AccountName,
          Parent, Child, ChildCmd,
          RmmTime, RmmTool, RmmCmd,
          LateralTargets, LateralFirst, LateralCmds,
          DelayToLateralMin = datetime_diff('minute', LateralFirst, ExploitTime)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

| ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|ScreenConnect\.(ClientService|Service|WindowsClient)|ns|nsppe|java|javaw|tomcat9|pc-app)\.exe$/i
